connector.name: Tw Market Data
connector.registryDescription: Taiwan stock market data (TWMD): official-source, point-in-time-safe datasets via read-only tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.twmarketdata.com over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.twmarketdata, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: TWMD API key (get one at https://twmarketdata.com). A key-free trial tier is available for sample tickers.
